passive.name: Umbra Blades
passive.description:
Every few seconds, Nocturne's next attack strikes surrounding enemies for bonus physical damage and heals himself. 

Nocturne's basic attacks reduce this cooldown.

primaryAbilities.name: Duskbringer
primaryAbilities.description: Nocturne throws a shadow blade that deals damage, leaves a Dusk Trail, and causes champions to leave a Dusk Trail. While on the trail, Nocturne can move through units and has increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Nocturne throws a shadow blade, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and leaving a dusk trail for {{ trailduration }} seconds. Enemy champions hit also leave a trail.

While on the trail, Nocturne is Ghosted and gains {{ movespeed }}% Move Speed and {{ bonustrailad }} Attack Damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Shroud of Darkness
primaryAbilities.description: Nocturne empowers his blades, passively gaining Attack Speed. Activating Shroud of Darkness allows Nocturne to fade into the shadows, creating a magical barrier which blocks a single enemy ability and doubles his passive Attack Speed if successful.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: Nocturne gains {{ activeas }}% Attack Speed.

Active: Nocturne creates a shadow barrier for 1.5 seconds that blocks the next enemy Ability. If an Ability is blocked, this Ability's passive effect is increased to {{ activeas*2 }}% Attack Speed for {{ doubleasduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Unspeakable Horror
primaryAbilities.description: Nocturne plants a nightmare into his target's mind, dealing damage each second and applying fear to the target if they do not get out of range by the end of the duration.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: Nocturne gains {{ tooltipfearms*100 }}% Move Speed toward Feared enemies.

Active: Nocturne plants a nightmare tether into his target, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage over {{ leashduration }} seconds. If the tether remains unbroken, the target is Feared for {{ ccduration }} second(s).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Paranoia
primaryAbilities.description: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Nocturne darkens the map, reducing the sight radius of all enemy champions and removing their vision of allies for {{ paranoiaduration }} seconds. Nocturne can <recast>Recast</recast> this Ability during the duration to launch himself at an enemy champion dealing <physicalDamage>{{ damage }} physical damage</physicalDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
